researcher_notes: Named exclusion embedded in the source: this pathway only applies to applicants who have EXCLUSIVELY these qualifications and no higher-value school-leaving certificate (Fachhochschulreife or Abitur) — “...ausschließlich über folgende Voraussetzungen verfügen und keinen höherwertigen Schulabschluss... haben”. This is a domestic Hessian-law pathway (Verordnung über den Zugang beruflich Qualifizierter zu den Hochschulen im Lande Hessen), not applicable to applicants using foreign qualifications, who instead go through the anabin/Studienkolleg pathway.

requirement_text: A cut-off deadline always exists if the end of the application deadline falls on 15.01. (summer semester) or 15.07. (winter semester) and this date is marked with an * star on the Application Deadlines page... By the end of this period, your online application must have the status “sent”... The date of the postmark is not decisive, but the actual receipt at TU Darmstadt... Applications submitted after this deadline shall be excluded from the procedure.
source_authority_note: tu-darmstadt.de fails looksOfficial() (no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix) — this is the institution's own official page. Needs the officialDomains-provenance fix documented in source-authority-gap.md, not a lowered evidence bar.
limitations: Critically, the cut-off/exclusion behaviour is explicitly gated on the asterisk (*) marker next to a given 15.01/15.07 date on the deadlines table, not on the date pattern alone — several 15.07.26 rows in this batch's deadline records are published WITHOUT an asterisk (see DL-2026-08-21-DAR0004 and DL-2026-08-21-DAR0007) and per this rule are therefore NOT strict cut-off/postmark-excluded deadlines, even though the calendar date is identical to programmes that are.
researcher_notes: Also states: “For some degree programmes, registration at hochschulstart.de for participation in the ‘Dialogue-oriented Service Procedure’ is additionally required for an application for the winter semester by the end of this deadline” — the specific list of affected programmes is linked from this page but was not independently fetched in this batch.

requirement_text: “Technische Universität Darmstadt” / “TU Darmstadt” does not appear in uni-assist's list of member universities. The only Darmstadt-named institution listed is “Hochschule Darmstadt (h_da) – University of Applied Sciences”, a separate institution in the same city.
source_authority_note: Official application system. Per coordination DECISION 1 (2026-08-21, documented in source-authority-gap.md), an application system is HIGH authority for facts it owns (platform-wide deadlines/eligibility it sets), not authoritative for a specific university's own programme-level facts even when displayed on the platform.
limitations: This is a negative finding (absence from a list), not a quoted sentence, hence extracted_summary rather than verbatim_quoted.
researcher_notes: Directly answers this lane's uni-assist question for TU Darmstadt: TU Darmstadt is NOT a uni-assist member institution. All applicants — domestic and international — apply exclusively through TU Darmstadt's own TUCaN portal; TU Darmstadt's own international-admissions page corroborates this from the other direction (“the online application portal TUCaN is available for all prospective students and the same application deadlines apply”, REQ-2026-08-21-DAR0001). This is the “doesn't use uni-assist at all” case referenced in this lane's brief, distinct from TU Berlin's finding earlier this batch (a uni-assist member whose deadlines still defer entirely to the university's own dates). No separate uni-assist deadline record was created for TU Darmstadt as a result — there is no uni-assist involvement to record a deadline for.
